title: Local Work, Global Progress: A Convergence Theory of AI Agent Collaboration
title_zh: 局部工作，全局进步：AI智能体协作的收敛理论

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出AI智能体协作的收敛理论，将协作形式化为块优化并证明线性收敛，实验显示多智能体团队比单智能体更快更优。 Teams of large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to complex tasks, but their collaboration protocols are mostly designed empirically, without convergence guarantees. We formalize collaborative problem solving as block optimization: each agent improves one part of a shared solution, guided by its local objective plus a correction for how its changes affect the other parts. A coordinator checks every proposal against the global objective and merges proposals that do not interfere with each other. We prove linear convergence up to an error floor that vanishes when the corrections are exact. Interfering proposals can also be merged once their combination has been checked; the rate then depends on how well the proposals actually combine, not on worst-case interactions. With GPT-OSS-120B agents on robot routing, a three-agent team finds collision-free plans in every run, better than those of a single agent that controls all robots. On a larger routing task, a six-agent team completes its search about twice as fast as the single agent (in median). Merging the best checked combination of proposals, rather than only proposals that do not interfere, cuts the team's search time by about 30%. With constants measured on the runs, our convergence bound holds in every round and follows the observed progress. We also test the theory on query planning in SQLite and on a synthetic task.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出AI智能体协作的收敛理论，将协作形式化为块优化并证明线性收敛，实验显示多智能体团队比单智能体更快更优。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体团队正越来越多地应用于复杂任务，但其协作协议大多是凭经验设计的，缺乏收敛性保证。 我们将协作式问题求解形式化为块优化：每个智能体在局部目标以及一个对其改动如何影响其他部分的修正项的引导下，改进共享解的一个部分。 协调器依据全局目标检查每个提案，并合并互不干扰的提案。 我们证明了直到一个误差下限的线性收敛，当修正项精确时该下限趋于消失。 相互干扰的提案也可以在验证其组合之后进行合并；此时收敛速率取决于提案实际组合的效果，而非最坏情况下的交互。 在机器人路径规划任务中使用GPT-OSS-120B智能体时，三智能体团队在每次运行中都能找到无碰撞的规划方案，且效果优于控制所有机器人的单个智能体。 在更大规模的路径规划任务上，六智能体团队完成搜索的速度约为单个智能体的两倍（以中位数计）。 合并经过检验的最佳提案组合，而不仅仅是互不干扰的提案，可将团队的搜索时间缩短约30%。 在运行中测得的常数下，我们的收敛界在每一轮都成立，并与观察到的进展相吻合。 我们还在SQLite的查询规划和一个合成任务上测试了该理论。
